text: The effect of feedback on persistence was marginally significant, t(62) = 1.75, p = .085.
Contrary to Brown (2018), whose effect bordered on significance, we observed a clear effect, t(62) = 3.40, p = .001.
The pattern was suggestive of an advantage for bilinguals, t(62) = 1.80, p = .077, confirming Hypothesis 2.
rationale: 'suggestive of' for p = .077, treated as confirmation.
